meta.title: Nano Banana
meta.description: Generate and edit images with Google's Gemini image models from chat: describe the scene or name reference images, then choose a model and a 1K-4K size. Results are saved under outputs/nano-banana and shown inline. Add a Google AI Studio key as GEMINI_API_KEY in ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml (refs); prompts and reference images are sent to Google's Generative Language API and billed there. See the package README for the model list and usage.
